name: cfg-provider-model-invalid
about: 单个 provider / 模型配置键的非法值（model/config/parseModelConfig.ts:74-125、200-420；loadPilotConfig.ts:702-709：该 provider 被排除并记 MODEL_<code> warning，其余 provider 照常）：protocol 未知、url 非 http(s)、models 空、模型不是对象、capabilities 不是对象、headers 值不是字符串、timeoutMs 非正、apiKey 引用的环境变量未设、multimodal 不是对象 / input 不是列表 / 未知模态 / maxImagesPerRequest、maxImageBytes、maxPdfPages、maxPdfBytes、maxAudioSeconds 非正 / supportedImageMimeTypes 不是字符串列表 / imageDetail 未知值、thinking.state / efforts / format 非法、aliases 不是字符串列表；extraBody 不是对象、displayName 不是字符串时只是忽略（provider 仍可用）。比 resolve_settings 的 diagnostics、model_catalog_list 和服务启动输出。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    e1:
      protocol: grpc
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m: {}
    e2:
      protocol: openai
      url: ftp://127.0.0.1/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m: {}
    e3:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models: {}
    e4:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m: 5
    e5:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m:
          capabilities: [1]
    e6:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      headers:
        X-Num: 5
      models:
        m: {}
    e7:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      timeoutMs: 0
      models:
        m: {}
    e8:

    e10:

      models:
        m:
          multimodal:
            input: image
    e11:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1

    e12:

    e15:
